github-actions.description: Also manage action pins inside the workflow templates: consumers vendor these files, and the drift check reports a difference in the pinned SHA alone only as a notice (issue #353). Managing the template here makes it move in the same cycle as the consumers.

customManagers.description: go-check.yml builds gosec with go install at a commit on gosec's master branch, because the securego/gosec action runs a release image that cannot load Go 1.27.2 packages (netresearch/.github#504). The github-actions manager tracked the old action pin; this keeps the go install pin on master's newest commit the same way.
